name: Computer AI
author: ajo
description: Voice assistant for Omarchy: a bar icon with a drop-down panel — press a hotkey or click the icon, speak, and a pluggable AI agent (Claude, Grok, ChatGPT, ...) answers aloud and can operate the desktop. The agent keeps running (and speaking) while the panel is closed. After install run: bin/setup.sh --wire.

barWidget.description: One bar icon and one drop-down panel: a Jarvis-style voice assistant with a live orb, streaming activity, and a persistent agent that keeps working while the panel is hidden.
